impact.text: Users pay full fees and token amounts for campaigns that can never distribute rewards

precondition_sources.text: A user supplies a startTimestamp parameter when creating a campaign via _createCampaign.
The supplied startTimestamp is in the past relative to block.timestamp (startTimestamp < block.timestamp), including a campaign that has already fully elapsed.
The campaign duration is at least 1 hour.

intent_sources.text: Campaign creation should enforce that the start timestamp is not in the past, i.e. startTimestamp >= block.timestamp (or equivalently startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp).
